source.title: Marcille - Elven Mage
source.name: Marcille
source.description: The most brilliant female student in the school's history, she weaves a colorful tapestry of spells through chanting.

skills.name: Silver-White Wings that Streak Across the Skies

description.raw: Passive. All of Marcille's skills require chanting to cast. Her chanting speed is affected by both Haste and ATK SPD, and she continuously attempts to cast her various skills. Each time Marcille finishes chanting, she permanently increases her Haste by 10 and Energy Recover Rate by 5%, stacking up to 10 times. Active. Marcille immediately spends 200 Energy and continues to chant ata a cost of 80 Energy per second. Summons Sky Fish to dash across the battlefield and deal 500% (ATK-based) + 50% (SP-based) damage to enemies in its path. The base chanting frequency for summoning Sky Fish is once every 2s.

skills.name: Explosive Spell

description.raw: After chanting for 3s, Marcille unleashes an Explosive Spell in the area with the most enemies, dealing 300% (ATK-based) + 40% (SP-based) damage to all enemies within a 1-tile radius.

skills.description_lite: After chanting for a while, Marcille unleashes an Explosive Spell, dealing AOE damage.

skills.name: Magical Flash

description.raw: After chanting for 2s, Marcille generates a magical flash of light around an ally surrounded by enemies, recovering 300% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) of the ally's HP, while dealing 240% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) damage to all nearby enemies and blinding them for 4 + 0.4 (SP-based)s.

skills.description_lite: After chanting for a while, Marcille unleashes a magical flash, healing an ally while damaging and blinding nearby enemies.

skills.name: Ancient Magic

description.raw: Marcille generates an ancient magic circle at her feet. After chanting for 3s, Marcille revives an allied hero and recovers 400% (ATK-based) HP for them. This skill can only be cast once per battle. During Battle preparation, if there is an ally placed 1 tile in front of Marcille, this skill will target that ally. However, if Laios is on the team, this skill can revive him one additional time (no position requirement and does not consume the skill's use limit), but this can only trigger once per battle. If the chanting is interrupted, this skill cannot be recast for 5s.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: During battle, Marcille recovers 10 additional Energy per second for each ally who is currently providing her with a buff, up to 3 stacks. At 3 stacks, she becomes unaffected.
